items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: Prince Morris, that's the Undertaker, he had parks built all around you know.

ctx.x: Would they play at different places while they were there?

Yeah, at the parks. Prince Morris, that's the Undertaker, he had parks built all around you know. There was three brothers in there, all was the Undertakers. But he was the one who used to book all the bands there.
Would they do an advertisement before they played?
